summary: An excerpt from a fiction book (Book 10, part 50) in which Greg, a Google employee, is confronted in his kitchen by a pudgy, pale man who claims to work for a DC firm employed by Google. Greg threatens to go to the press with a write-up, but the man dismisses this, suggests the paper would not find a confirming source, and offers Greg a job on a team to take over a flawed program called googlecleaner. The man pitches money, meaningful work, and a role in political life, which Greg rejects as an attempt to get him to smear political candidates.
one_line: Greg, a Google employee, refuses a kitchen-table job offer from a DC operative who wants him to smear political candidates.
key_facts: Greg is confronted in a kitchen by a man who says "I'm not a cop" and says he works for a DC firm in Google's employ.
The man describes his DC firm as "The inventors of swiftboating."
Greg says "I'll go to the press" and that he has "written this all up."
The man says the Chronicle would "try to find a confirming source" and claims "They won't find it."
The man tells Greg his profile "looks just like it looked the day you landed at SFO."
The man says "I'm in the win-win business" and claims to be billing Google for the meeting.
The man advises rinsing the beans before grinding to "take some of the bitterness out and brings up the oils."
The man takes off his jacket, rolls up his cuffs, and slips a cheap digital watch into his pocket before working at the sink.
The man says "We're drafting a team for Building 49," and Greg replies "There is no building 49."
The team is to have "its own buginizer, to own googlecleaner."
The man says "Maya's code wasn't very efficient" and that every run of it "clobbers the whole farm."
The man offers "money," "good work," "smart colleagues," and "A chance to participate in the political life of your country."
Greg responds "You're on crack" and refuses to help.
Greg concludes that if the man thinks he will "smear political candidates in exchange for favors, you're even crazier than I thought."
